[CR CR4391r3 for 38.331] Reason for change: This running CR introduces the support of Rel18 features for sidelink. Summary of change: In 5.2 and 5.3, introduce the impact due to the additional frequency list and RLC bearer list. In 5.8, introduce the impact to SUI message, synchronization procedure, PC5-RRC impact for SL-CA configuration and so on. In 6.2, 6.3, 6.4, 6.6, introduce the impact on SIB12, SUI message, sidelink configuration via Uu-RRC and PC5-RRC. In 8 and 9, introduce the impact to specified configuration and pre-configuration. Consequences if not approved: Rel18 features for sidelink are not supported.
